Metadata.description: AI-assisted analysis of German rental and employment contracts with highlighted clauses, quotes and open metrics.

Footer.disclaimer: Automatic assessment, may contain errors and is not legal advice. Portfolio project by Falko Kammel.

Start.title: Understand your contract before you sign it.
Start.lead: Upload a rental or employment contract. Vertragscheck highlights notable clauses right in the text, with a verbatim quote and a short explanation.
Start.note: No account needed. Uploaded contracts are deleted automatically after 30 days.
Start.excerptBefore: The tenant pays a deposit of
Start.excerptAfter: , due at the start of the lease.
Start.excerptReason: A deposit may not exceed three months' net rent (§ 551 BGB). Any higher amount is invalid to that extent.
Start.step1Text: Upload a PDF and choose the contract type. Text PDFs up to 10 MB.
Start.step2Text: A language model classifies every clause. Each quote is checked against the original text, and invented passages are discarded.
Start.step3Text: Notable passages are highlighted in the text, with an explanation, the cost and the model used for the analysis.

Upload.consent: I understand that the analysis is automatic, may contain errors and is not legal advice. Sample or redacted contracts work best.
Upload.limitNote: Without an account: up to 3 analyses per day. Processing in the EU (Frankfurt), automatic deletion after 30 days.

Transparency.title: Transparency
Transparency.lead: What does an analysis cost, how fast is it, and how often is the model wrong? The figures come live from the database.
Transparency.droppedHint: not found in the original text
Transparency.budgetRule1: At 100 % the app blocks new analyses automatically until the end of the month. Sample analyses stay available.
Transparency.budgetRule2: Without an account at most 3 analyses per day, plus a captcha against automated requests.
Transparency.budgetRule3: In addition, an AWS budget alarm for the whole account.
Transparency.modelsTitle: Model comparison on the test set
Transparency.modelsLead: Sample contracts with hand-marked clauses. Every prompt or model change is measured against it.
